subject: Russian schools will double the share of class time devoted to basic military training
posts: Schools pivot to combat readiness as military training hours surge. Russian schools will double the share of class time devoted to basic military training. Evidence: National security, militarized youth, state control. #Aletheia #Russia

Education Minister Sergey Kravtsov announced that military training will rise from 20% to 50% of instruction time for grades 6-11, alongside new 'Spiritual and Moral Culture' courses featuring war-themed documentaries.
